quest.title: A New Storm Is Brewing
quest.description: Sister Vind wishes to get to the top of the watchtower but something has gotten in her way. She's trying to think of a way through...

dialogues.speaker: Vind
dialogues.text: *sigh* How am I going to get past...

dialogues.speaker: Vind
dialogues.text: Oh, hello... Is something wrong?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What are you doing?

dialogues.speaker: Vind
dialogues.text: I'm trying to get to the watchtower at Stormbearer Point — I want to see if there is a storm brewing out at sea or not.

dialogues.speaker: Vind
dialogues.text: But there's a group of monsters blocking the way up ahead. I don't know how to get past.

dialogues.speaker: Vind
dialogues.text: Don't worry, I'm not about to ask you to go to the watchtower for me!

dialogues.speaker: Vind
dialogues.text: It is my duty, and I must see it fulfilled no matter what it takes.

dialogues.speaker: Vind
dialogues.text: You probably have things to do. Go on, don't worry about me, I'll figure it out.

talks.objective: Clear out the monsters on the watchtower

dialogues.speaker: Vind
dialogues.text: Is something the matter?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: The monsters are gone now.

dialogues.speaker: Vind
dialogues.text: Really! Thanks be to the Anemo Archon...

dialogues.speaker: Vind
dialogues.text: I mean— Sorry, I take that back. You are the one I should be thanking!

dialogues.speaker: Vind
dialogues.text: How can I repay you? Oh! I've got it...

dialogues.speaker: Vind
dialogues.text: Come and find me at the top of the watchtower. I'll wait for you.

dialogues.speaker: Vind
dialogues.text: Mmm... Calm seas and no wind again today.

dialogues.speaker: Vind
dialogues.text: Generations of my family have kept watch here on behalf of Mondstadt, looking for any signs of an oncoming storm. It was Lady Vennessa who first entrusted us with this task.

dialogues.speaker: Vind
dialogues.text: Since Lord Barbatos began protecting Mondstadt, we have not seen a single storm, and the watchtowers have slowly fallen into disrepair.

dialogues.speaker: Vind
dialogues.text: Even so, I still cannot bring myself to stop coming here to this watchtower.

response.speaker: Vind
response.text: Thank you. But, on the subject of my duty...

response.speaker: Vind
response.text: ...I would prefer never to have to fulfill it.

response.speaker: Vind
response.text: Anyway. Thank you for your help. These Windwheel Asters are for you.

response.speaker: Vind
response.text: In the past, my family would look at how well the Windwheel Aster grows in an area to determine how strong the wind was there.

response.speaker: Vind
response.text: The Windwheel Aster can grow neither in places with no wind, nor anywhere that is plagued by strong storms.

response.speaker: Vind
response.text: It can only flourish in places like Mondstadt, where the wind is gentle and nourishing.

response.speaker: Vind
response.text: Let's hope they continue to prosper here forever.

response.speaker: Vind
response.text: Yes. I hope that part of history is one that never repeats itself.

dialogues.speaker: Vind
dialogues.text: Hmm... maybe if I run fast enough I can get all the way to the top without getting hurt...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: She talks like she's got this one covered, but boy there are a lot of monsters...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Come on, let's clear out the area for Ms. Vind shall we?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Look at her... She's seriously thinking of just making an almighty run for it...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: People of such good character deserve a bit of help, if you ask Paimon.

choices.text: I've never seen such dedication in all my life...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: That would be the worst thing that could happen.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Let's not let it happen that way. Come on, get rid of these monsters.
